checkOrder: 5. profiles/decks/usage/recentDecks errors throw -> 500; events/transcripts/slideTranscripts errors are ignored (:52-56)

summary.totalDecks30d: int, decks created since cutoff (name says 30d whatever `days` is)
summary.decksToday: int, decks in range whose created_at UTC date == today

bodyShape.dailyActivity: [{date:'YYYY-MM-DD', decks:int, costUsd:number}] exactly `days` entries, oldest first, ending today
bodyShape.users: [{id, email ('—' if null), createdAt, lifetimeDecks, decksToday, isAdmin, totalSlidesGenerated, totalRefinements, totalExports, lastSeenAt|null}] all profiles, created_at desc
bodyShape.recentDecks: [{id, title ('Untitled' if empty), ownerEmail ('—' if unknown), status, createdAt, creationMethod|null, slideCount|null, refineCount, exportCount}] last 20 decks overall (NOT limited by days)
bodyShape.events: [{userId, userEmail, eventName, properties, pagePath, createdAt}] analytics_events since cutoff, newest first, max 2000
bodyShape.transcripts: [{id, userEmail, deckId, turnCount, totalChars, messages ([] default), brief ({} default), createdAt, completedAt}] last 50 intake transcripts overall (NOT limited by days)
bodyShape.topClicks: [{text, path, count}] element_clicked events grouped by path|text, top 50 by count
bodyShape.perUserClicks: [{email, total, topText, topCount}] per user with element_clicked events, total desc
bodyShape.slideTranscripts: [{id, userEmail, deckId, slideNumber, messages ([] default), refineCount, updatedAt}] last 100 slide_edit_transcripts by updated_at (NOT limited by days)

errors.when: profiles, decks (range), usage_events or recent-decks query errors

quirks: summary keys are named *30d but follow `days` (admin-metrics.ts:70, 196-197).
days=0 yields 30, not 1 (`|| 30` runs before the clamp).
recentDecks, transcripts and slideTranscripts ignore `days`; events, decks-in-range and usage use it.
events is capped at 2000 rows, so topClicks/perUserClicks are computed from at most 2000 events.
Failures of the analytics_events, intake_transcripts and slide_edit_transcripts queries are ignored (empty arrays), so the route still returns 200 when those tables are missing (admin-metrics.ts:56).
Date buckets mix server-local date arithmetic (setDate) with UTC slicing (toISOString().slice(0,10)); on a UTC host they agree.
No pagination over profiles: `users` lists every profile.
beforeAnyState: With empty tables: all counts 0, `days` zeroed dailyActivity buckets, empty arrays.
